title: How an Octopus Can Squeeze into a Beer Can - Nautilus
author: Devin Reese
text: Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisementZoologyHow an Octopus Can Squeeze into a Beer CanOr not, depending on the speciesDRBy Devin Reese9:00 AM CST on November 6, 2026Add Nautilus to GoogleWe’ve long known that octopuses have an uncanny ability to squeeze through small spaces. Whether they prefer beer cans or beer bottles, they’re adept at compressing their bodies to escape danger. But how? A new study published in the Journal of Experimental Biology uncovered some secrets of this octopus refuge behavior.Lead study author Wenci Xin, a mechanical engineer from the National University of Singapore, and his coauthors from Italy and Austria conducted experiments with three subadult common octopuses (Octopus vulgaris) collected by fishermen in France as well as four juvenile Mexican four-eyed octopuses (Octopus maya) raised from eggs in the lab. In multiple trials, each octopus was challenged with passing through a barrier in an acrylic box using either a large hole or a small hole relative to their eye distance.
